source_snapshot.procedure: Compare IB/OOB SDR and sensor lists plus BMC Web Sensor List.
source_snapshot.criteria: Name, description and reading match SPEC in all views.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES but OOB-only/truncated fallback and user confirmation.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE with exact SDR identity, complete cross-path data and supplied range/tolerance.

old_problem: The exact SDR record, field/unit/range oracle and IB/OOB/UI normalization were missing; grep or truncated output could select the wrong duplicate and subjective user confirmation could not establish compliance.
disposition_reason: IPMI SDR/sensor reads are standard, read-only and fully machine-verifiable. ED-03 permits the project sensor record, expected operating range and channel mapping as runtime configuration. The review now defines fail-closed identity, complete evidence and allowed sampling skew without inventing threshold values.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2272 and 2273, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical records and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve full IB and OOB `sdr elist`, sensor-list and BMC Web name/description/reading-to-SPEC comparisons.
Bind target by SDR record ID/entity plus name rather than first grep hit; capture complete untruncated raw records on each authorized path.
Decode units, linearization, thresholds/status and numeric reading, then compare with the signed range/tolerance and bounded sampling skew.
Keep UI as a real separate evidence surface with captured field mapping; it cannot override raw IB/OOB disagreement.
No credentials, IPMI/Web query, log clear, sensor write or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: TEMP_HIB_PEX complete IB/OOB SDR, sensor and Web cross-check
test_case.purpose: Verify the exact TEMP_HIB_PEX SDR definition and live reading match the approved sensor specification and agree across independent in-band, out-of-band and BMC Web views within configured timing tolerance.
required_package: IB/OOB controller/channel map and allowed sampling skew
Protected credentials and BMC Web field map/capture access
test_case.test_command: Collect complete untruncated SDR and sensor records via each supported IB/OOB path, bind the exact record, decode all approved fields and readings, capture the mapped Web entry, then compare identity/metadata/status/range and cross-path values using the configured skew/tolerance.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one approved TEMP_HIB_PEX record is present; its name/description/entity/units/threshold/status match SPEC, live reading is within the signed range, and IB/OOB/Web values agree within allowed temporal/format normalization.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the bound SPEC and complete three-surface match. Missing runtime SPEC blocks execution, not review. Absent/duplicate/ambiguous record, unit/status/range mismatch, path disagreement beyond tolerance or missing required UI evidence is FAIL/BLOCKED per applicability.
safety_gate: Verify controller/channel identities and protect credentials.
No truncated output or arbitrary duplicate selection.
Stop on malformed/non-numeric data or ambiguous mapping; preserve logs.
expected_evidence: Exact record identity and decoded metadata/readings
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected; on path or identity ambiguity stop and preserve complete raw data without sensor writes, service restart or log clearing.

source_conflict.reason: All source surfaces consistently target the same sensor and SPEC.

blocked.reason: Standard read-only collection is defined; project sensor values are runtime inputs.
